move: panel rises, title letters stagger up, NEW badge wipes in with cover slide, burst lines, shine
how: A dark panel with a per-letter headline, a paragraph, and a purple NEW badge made of a white cover, per-letter text, a shine strip and an outline ring, plus eight radial line divs. 0-17%: the panel rises 40px and fades (expo.out); at 4% the headline letters rise from yPercent 100 with a 0.025s stagger; at 12% the paragraph fades up. At 17% the badge grows scaleX 0->1 from its left edge (expo.out), at 24% the white cover slides off scaleX 1->0 from the right (expo.inOut) and at 26% the N-E-W letters bounce up with back.out(2), 0.06s stagger; at 30% the badge settles from rotation -6 with elastic.out(1,.5), the outline ring scales 1.5 fading, and eight lines shoot outward from the badge centre (scaleY 0->1 along their angle, r 130px, expo.out). At 36% the shine sweeps across. At 60% a 1.06 yoyo pulse. Exit at 85%: badge collapses scaleX->0 (expo.in), headline letters fly up out, paragraph and panel fade up.
adapt: Change the headline, badge word, paragraph, purple (#6c5cff) accent and panel colours. Keep the cover-slide reveal (0.45s expo.inOut), the 0.06s letter stagger with back.out(2) and the elastic settle.
port: mount(el, shot) builds the panel, splits the title and badge text into spans, and creates the eight lines inside el; animate(el, shot, D) returns the timeline with positions as fractions of D (badge 0.17D, cover 0.24D, burst 0.29D, exit 0.85D). The burst origin uses hard-coded 1280x720 centre offsets (bx/by) that must be computed from the badge's position within el; scope all selectors to el; the from() tweens need immediateRender:false when nested (the fromTo ones already set it).
caveats: burst line origin is hard-coded for a 1280x720 stage
from() tweens on panel, letters and badge need immediateRender:false when nested
ends empty, no return to frame one
